title: Oil Rig Workers Share a Cabin With a Stranger
asof: Figures as of 2026 · full video on the channel

shots.s: On a North Sea oil rig, you might share your cabin with someone you barely see.
A bathroom shared with the cabin next door.
You work days. Your cabin mate works nights.
So one of you is usually at work.
Britain's regulator updated its rules in May 2026.

d.small: minimum for a two-person cabin · HSE, 2026

shots.s: Under nine square meters? Normally too small for two.
Never more than two people in it at once.
Since 2008, every cabin there is single.
Could you share a room for two weeks?
